title: ChromAlphaGenome: Multi-Modal Non-Coding Variant Prioritization, Chromatin Accessibility Modeling & Splice-Disruption Pipeline
description: ChromAlphaGenome is a reproducible regulatory genomics package developed by the Computational Genomics & Agentic Systems (CGAS) Lab at Northwestern University. It harmonizes 1-megabase cis-regulatory track predictions from the AlphaGenome atlas with ChromBPNet base-resolution chromatin accessibility foot-printing and MaxEntScan donor/acceptor splice-site disruption (ΔPSI) modeling across ClinVar, gnomAD v4, and ENCODE cCRE benchmarks.
